NEWS 


FROM THE MONTREAL YMCA 


1441 DRUMMOND ST., MONTREAL 
TELEPHONE 849-5331, EXT. 57 


A city-wide Swim Symposium will he held by the Montreal 
Y.M.C.A. at the Downtown Branch on Sunday March 21st from 


1:00 to ):30 p.m. 


A planning committee headed by Milton D'Ganigan and Reg. 
Cooke has designed the program to review swim standards 
with demonstrations on Junior and Senior Life Saving - by 
Bob Poirier; Master Swimming - by Grant McMilland and Boh 
Meadcn3, and Scuba and Skin Diving by Ian Tippet, Gaston 
Routhier and Charles Zelensky. 


Wide representation from all Y branches is expected. 


For further details contact: 
Milton D'Ganigan, Aquatic Director, 


Downtown Y.M.C.A., VI9-5331.
